mainEntity.name: Does GoDaddy's built-in form support conditional logic?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. GoDaddy's Websites + Marketing Contact Form lets you reorder fields and add basic ones (text, dropdown, checkbox), but there is no way to show or hide fields based on prior answers. If you need a form that asks different questions to different respondents, you need an external builder. Formester handles this natively on every plan with conditional logic.

mainEntity.name: Where do I paste the embed code in GoDaddy?

acceptedAnswer.text: Inside the GoDaddy Websites + Marketing editor, open the page you want the form on, click Add Section, scroll to the HTML option (it sits under More), and select it. Paste your Formester iframe snippet into the HTML editor and save. Publish the site to push it live.

mainEntity.name: Will the embedded form match my GoDaddy site's design?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, more closely than the native form. Formester gives you brand colors, custom fonts, and custom CSS on paid plans, so the form picks up your GoDaddy site's look. GoDaddy's native form only offers layout presets and shows GoDaddy styling cues.

mainEntity.name: Can I accept Stripe or PayPal payments through a form on GoDaddy?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not through GoDaddy's native contact form. Payments aren't part of Websites + Marketing's form builder. Formester ships native Stripe and PayPal fields, with AES-256 encryption on the payment layer, so you can collect deposits, full payments, or recurring charges through a form embedded on any GoDaddy page.

mainEntity.name: How do I get notified when someone submits the form?

acceptedAnswer.text: Formester emails you on every submission by default. You can also send the submission as a PDF to the respondent, push it into Google Sheets, fire a webhook, post to Slack, create a HubSpot contact, or trigger an n8n or Zapier flow. All of these run on the Free plan.

mainEntity.name: Does the form work on mobile-optimized GoDaddy sites?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Formester's embed is responsive by default and will fit the width of whatever container you drop it into, including GoDaddy's mobile layouts. Test it in GoDaddy's editor Preview mode before you publish to confirm the height is right for your form length.

mainEntity.name: Can I switch from GoDaddy's form to Formester later without losing data?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Leave GoDaddy's contact form in place while you build the Formester version, embed Formester on a new section, then delete GoDaddy's section once you've verified submissions are landing where you want them. Past GoDaddy submissions stay in your GoDaddy email. New submissions land in Formester from the moment you publish.

mainEntity.name: How does Formester compare to Wix or Squarespace's native form builders?

acceptedAnswer.text: Same story as GoDaddy. Wix Forms and Squarespace's Form block both ship basic field sets, limited logic, and limited payments. Formester replaces them with an embed that brings real conditional logic, real payments, real file handling, and 30+ field types. The embed flow is identical on each platform: copy the iframe, paste into an HTML or Embed block, publish.
